description: This file defines a static class 'TableFormatter' within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Tables namespace. It provides various static methods for manipulating and formatting tables in a document, including expanding table size, setting rounded corners, adjusting outer cell widths, copying row shading, removing borders, inserting glue columns, and surrounding content with a table.

classes.name: TableFormatter
classes.description: A static utility class offering table formatting and manipulation methods in MigraDoc.

methods.name: ExpandTable
methods.description: Expands the table by adding specified numbers of rows and columns on all sides or specific sides.

methods.name: SetRoundedCorners
methods.description: Sets the corner cells of the table to have rounded corners.

methods.name: SetOuterCellsWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of outer columns and height of outer rows to specified values.

methods.name: CopyNeighboringRowShadingToTop
methods.description: Copies shading from a row below to the top rows.

methods.name: CopyNeighboringRowShadingToBottom
methods.description: Copies shading from a row above to the bottom rows.

methods.name: RemoveInnerHorizontalBorders
methods.description: Removes inner horizontal borders between specified rows.

methods.name: RemoveInnerVerticalBorders
methods.description: Removes inner vertical borders between specified columns.

methods.name: InsertGlueColumn
methods.description: Inserts a 'glue' column to prevent page breaks at specified table regions.

methods.name: SurroundContentWithTable
methods.description: Wraps a specified number of elements with a new table with given column width.
